name: E4a_move_classification
description: h=7 move classes up(>+3%)/down(<-3%)/flat; LGBM multiclass (balanced) vs always-flat and 7-day-trend persistence; DM on 0/1 misclassification loss
verdict: PARTIAL WIN: macro-F1 beats both baselines (0.52 vs flat 0.24, trend 0.41). Pre-agreed DM on 0/1 loss: significant vs trend (p=1e-4) but NOT vs always-flat (p=0.89; accuracy 56.5 vs 56.4 %), so the strict rule is not met. Supplementary DM on class-balanced 0/1 loss (consistent with macro-F1): significant vs both overall and for coconut, pepper, rubber, tapioca; banana not vs trend (p=0.23).
